# Sanota (Pvt) Ltd

> Sanota (Private) Limited (Company Registration No: PV 74540) is a Sri Lankan industrial engineering and automation company founded in 2010 by engineer Sahan C. Ranasinghe (alumnus of University of Moratuwa). It designs and builds custom machinery, integrates PLC/HMI/IoT systems, retrofits ageing industrial machines, and provides Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) for tea, agriculture, food-processing, and manufacturing clients. Software, cloud telemetry, and connected dashboards are delivered in partnership with affiliated software company Knoweb.

## Key Facts & Entity Data
- Legal Name: Sanota (Private) Limited
- Alternate Names: Sanota Global, Sanota Pvt Ltd, Sanota
- Founded: 2010, Sri Lanka
- Company Registration: PV 74540
- Founder & Principal Engineer: Eng. Sahan C. Ranasinghe (B.Sc. Eng., University of Moratuwa)
- Headquarters Address: 441/2C Wackwella Road, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
- Workshop & Engineering Facility: Bataganwila, Galle, Sri Lanka
- Telephone: +94 74 070 9989
- Email: info@sanotaglobal.com

## Notable Recognition & Global Awards
- **Smart Drain Project**: Sanota served as the commissioning and industrial IoT partner for the **Smart Drain** system (invented by Dr. Nadeesha Chandrasena / Urban Inventors). The project was recognized as one of only **10 global winners of the 2025 WIPO Global Awards** in Geneva, selected from 780 applications across 95 countries.
- Commissioning & IoT Case Study: https://www.sanotaglobal.com/case-studies/smart-drain-iot-flood-monitoring

## Core Engineering Services
- [Machine Retrofit & Modernization](https://www.sanotaglobal.com/services/machine-retrofit-modernization): Obsolete PLC panel replacement (Siemens, Omron, Mitsubishi, Allen-Bradley), rewiring, relay-to-PLC upgrades, and safety interlocks extending machinery lifespan at 30% of replacement cost.
- [PLC, HMI & IoT Integration](https://www.sanotaglobal.com/services/plc-hmi-iot-integration): Custom PLC/SCADA control panel assembly, sensor instrumentation, VFD motor control, and IIoT predictive maintenance dashboards.
- [Custom Machinery Design & Manufacturing](https://www.sanotaglobal.com/services/custom-machinery-manufacturing): Special-purpose machines (SPMs), automated test rigs, and bespoke processing equipment fabricated in Sri Lanka.
- [Machinery AMC & Lifecycle Support](https://www.sanotaglobal.com/services/amc-preventive-maintenance): Preventive maintenance, emergency breakdown callouts, calibration, and spare parts management.

## Industry Automation Solutions
- [Tea Factory Automation & Withering Control](https://www.sanotaglobal.com/industries/tea-factory-automation): Automated tea trough withering humidity and airflow controls, fluidized bed tea dryer (FBD) temperature retrofits, and factory data logging.
- [Greenhouse Automation & Smart Agriculture](https://www.sanotaglobal.com/industries/greenhouse-smart-agriculture): Commercial greenhouse climate controllers, multi-channel fertigation dosing skids, and IoT soil moisture/EC telemetry.
- [Food & Beverage Processing Machinery](https://www.sanotaglobal.com/industries/food-processing-machinery): Industrial dehydrators, stainless steel processing lines, cookers, and automated packaging machinery.
- [Manufacturing Automation](https://www.sanotaglobal.com/industries/manufacturing-automation): Assembly stations, conveyor synchronization, and material handling automation.

## Location & Regional Presence
- [Engineering Services in Galle & Southern Province](https://www.sanotaglobal.com/locations/galle): Local workshop support, fast on-site breakdown response, and automation services for factories and tea estates across Galle, Matara, and Hambantota.
